body:
I have used and abuse all addictive substances all my life.  But, as I get older it becomes harder and harder to get high.  I got so desperate I started abusing Lyrica.  At my age I would use anything because life just gets in the way when you also have kids to role model for.
Lyrica at first gave a surprising buzz.  Sort of like valium and dexamyl mixed together.  I started with 900mg and had to get up to 2700mg because it was so easy to build a tolerance. 4 days and it was history.  The RX was as well.  I was surprised at how much I can take.  I took all 2700mb in 12 hours.  Only side effect besides dry mouth is swelling in legs and feet.  Need a water pill.
